_doc: BUTZ-CHOQUIN dating cabinet (#27, Wave C closer, built 2026-07-17-eve; roster #33). THE CLIFF = 1951: Berrod-Regad buys the trademark and production moves Metz -> Saint-Claude; pipephil explicitly dates an arched 'Butz Choquin / A Metz' (without St Claude) pipe PRE-1951. SOURCES: staging/pipedia/Butz-Choquin.json + pipephil logo-butzchoquin + butzchoquin1 doc (Corot/Origine) (mirror). Name variants: buyer 2002 = 'Fabien Guichon' (pipedia) / 'Fabien Gichon' (pipephil) — same person, spelling noted.

history_anchors._doc: 1858 Metz: tobacconist Jean-Baptiste Choquin + his first workman (and son-in-law, m.1858) Gustave Butz create the CHOQUIN pipe — bent, flat-bottomed bowl, hollow ALBATROSS-BONE mouthpiece extension fixed with silver rings (the 'Origine' model; the painter Corot smoked one — Nadar photo, used in BC's own ads). Butz builds the Metz establishment under the Butz-Choquin name. Pre-1951: BC pipes crafted/distributed by various makers incl. Berrod-Regad itself. **1951 Berrod-Regad buys the trademark -> production relocates to SAINT-CLAUDE.** 1960 export-market entry (network rebuilt; Gold Cup of French good taste). Collection grows 10 -> 70 series. 1969-2002 Jean Paul Berrod manages; 2002 retires, sells to Fabien Guichon (Saint-Claude native). 2006 Denis Blanc (owner of EWA) takes over S.A. Berrod-Regad. Carvers: Paul Lanier (Maitre Pipier series) until retirement, then Alain Albuisson (also the Collection line) — artisan registry links. 1960s: designer JOE COLOMBO designs the 'Optimal' pipes (modèle déposé N°154217/154221).

brand_marks.physical: Standard: 'Butz-Choquin' + line (left), 'St Claude France' + shape number (right). PRE-1951 tell: arched 'Butz Choquin / A Metz' WITHOUT any St Claude wording. Modern Origine reissues: 'Butz-Choquin A Metz Origine' + 'St Claude France' (the St Claude side = modern). Origine extension: albatross bone (19th c.) vs white ACRYLIC (recent). Collection line: 3-tier star grading (2/3/4 stars), 'Fait main', encircled A (= Albuisson). Frontenac = 'Fabriqué par BC' second. Hurricane-type wind pipes exist (Auto-Sport).

table.note: any St-Claude wording on a BC = post-1951 (Berrod-Regad relocation cliff)
'A Metz' ALONE (no St Claude) = pre-1951 (see feature_era); combined with St Claude = modern heritage marking -> LOW here, the feature channel splits it

line_years._notes: optimal: Joe Colombo-designed, 'dating from the 60s' (pipephil) + modèle-déposé numbers; Colombo died 1971 -> [1960,1975] with slack, approx flagged. NOT encoded (undated): Origine (1858 model, made continuously incl. modern acrylic reissues — NEVER date by name), Collection (Albuisson, modern), Maitre Pipier (Lanier -> Albuisson, spans decades), Cybele, Bellevue, Select, Free Hand, C'est bon, Auto-Sport (Hurricane type), Frontenac (second), Dr Boston + Jacky Berrod (related pipephil pages, unread).

table.label: arched 'Butz Choquin / A Metz' WITHOUT St-Claude wording = pre-1951 (pipephil dates such a pipe explicitly pre-Berrod-Regad)
'Fait main' St-Claude hand-made marking = Berrod-Regad era onward (form undated)
hollow albatross-BONE Origine extension = the historic fitment (19th century per pipephil); acrylic white extension = recent reissue -> if BONE is confirmed, pipe leans early
synthetic/acrylic Origine extension = modern reissue era
